project_summary.name: Calculator Application
project_summary.description: A Python-based calculator application supporting four basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), chain calculations, decimal numbers, error handling, and history tracking.

functional_requirements.title: Basic Arithmetic Operations
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division operations on two operands.
acceptance_criteria: Given two valid numbers, when performing addition, the result shall be the sum
Given two valid numbers, when performing subtraction, the result shall be the difference
Given two valid numbers, when performing multiplication, the result shall be the product
Given two valid numbers, when performing division, the result shall be the quotient

functional_requirements.title: Chain Calculation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support chain calculations where the result of one operation becomes the first operand of the next operation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chain of operations, the system shall correctly apply operator precedence left-to-right
Given a chain like '2 + 3 * 4', the system shall compute step by step: (2+3)=5, then 5*4=20

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: The system shall handle division by zero and invalid input errors gracefully with meaningful error messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given division by zero, the system shall return an error message 'Division by zero is not allowed'
Given invalid numeric input, the system shall return an error message 'Invalid input: please enter valid numbers'

functional_requirements.title: Decimal Number Support
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support decimal (floating-point) numbers in all operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given decimal operands, the system shall compute correct decimal results
Given integer operands, the system shall return integer results where appropriate

functional_requirements.title: History Record
functional_requirements.description: The system shall maintain a history of all calculations performed during a session.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed calculation, the system shall record it in the history
Given a request to view history, the system shall display all past calculations with operands, operator, result, and timestamp

non_functional_requirements.title: Code Coverage
non_functional_requirements.description: The code coverage shall exceed 90% as measured by pytest-cov.

non_functional_requirements.title: Type Annotations
non_functional_requirements.description: All public APIs shall have complete type hints for parameters and return values.

non_functional_requirements.title: Documentation
non_functional_requirements.description: All public APIs shall have Google-style docstrings.

use_cases.name: Perform Basic Calculation
alternative_flows: If division by zero: system displays error message
If invalid input: system displays error message

use_cases.name: Perform Chain Calculation
main_flow: System computes result using previous result as first operand
alternative_flows: User can start a new calculation at any time

use_cases.name: View Calculation History
preconditions: At least one calculation has been performed
main_flow: System displays all past calculations with details
alternative_flows: If no history exists: system displays 'No history available'

risks.description: Floating-point precision issues in decimal calculations
risks.mitigation: Use Decimal type for precise arithmetic

risks.description: Chain calculation order of operations ambiguity
risks.mitigation: Document that calculations are performed left-to-right without precedence

project_summary.name: Calculator Application
project_summary.description: A Python-based calculator application supporting four basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), continuous chained calculations, error handling (division by zero, invalid input), decimal arithmetic, and a history feature.
project_summary.target_users: End users needing basic arithmetic calculations with history tracking
business_goals: Provide a reliable and user-friendly calculator
Ensure high code quality with >90% test coverage
Maintain code readability with complete type annotations and docstrings

entities.name: Calculation
entities.description: Represents a single arithmetic operation or a chain of operations

attributes.name: expression
attributes.description: The mathematical expression as a string

functional_requirements.name: Basic Arithmetic Operations
functional_requirements.description: The calculator shall support addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of two numbers.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given two numbers, the calculator returns correct sum, difference, product, and quotient.
AC2: Division by zero returns an error message 'Division by zero'.
AC3: Invalid input (non-numeric) returns an error message 'Invalid input'.

functional_requirements.name: Continuous Chained Calculation
functional_requirements.description: The calculator shall allow chaining multiple operations without re-entering the previous result.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: After a calculation, the result is used as the first operand for the next operation.
AC2: User can chain operations like 2 + 3 * 4 (following operator precedence or sequential? Assume sequential for simplicity).
AC3: The chain can be reset by starting a new calculation.

functional_requirements.name: Decimal Arithmetic
functional_requirements.description: The calculator shall support decimal numbers with floating-point precision.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Input like 3.14 + 2.86 returns 6.0.
AC2: Results are displayed with up to 10 decimal places.

functional_requirements.name: History Recording
functional_requirements.description: The calculator shall record all calculations with expression and result.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Each calculation is stored with expression string and result.
AC2: History is displayed in reverse chronological order.
AC3: History is limited to the last 100 entries.

functional_requirements.name: Clear History
functional_requirements.description: The user shall be able to clear the calculation history.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: User can clear all history entries.
AC2: After clearing, history is empty.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Code Coverage
nonfunctional_requirements.description: The codebase shall have test coverage greater than 90%.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: Line coverage > 90% as measured by pytest-cov

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Type Annotations
nonfunctional_requirements.description: All functions and methods shall have complete type annotations.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: 100% of functions have type hints (checked via mypy)

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Docstrings
nonfunctional_requirements.description: All public APIs (functions, classes, methods) shall have docstrings describing purpose, parameters, and return values.

 336|  - New result is displayed

 150|

 156|

 164|
 165|- [ ] AC3: The chain can be reset by starting a new calculation.

 256|## 3.6 用例规格 (UC)
 257|
 258|### UC-01: Perform Basic Calculation
 259|
 260|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 261|
 262|**前置条件**:
 263|
 264|  - Calculator is ready for input
 265|
 266|**主流程**:
 267|
 268|  1. 1. User enters first operand (e.g., 5)
 269|
 270|  2. 2. User selects operator (e.g., +)
 271|
 272|  3. 3. User enters second operand (e.g., 3)
 273|
 274|  4. 4. System computes result (8) and displays it
 275|
 276|  5. 5. System records the calculation in history
 277|
 278|**备选流程**:
 279|
 280|  - **当 Division by zero**:
 281|
 282|      - 3a. User enters 0 as second operand for division
 283|
 284|      - 4a. System displays 'Division by zero' error
 285|
 286|      - 5a. System does not record the calculation
 287|
 288|  - **当 Invalid input**:
 289|
 290|      - 1a. User enters non-numeric input
 291|
 292|      - 2a. System displays 'Invalid input' error
 293|
 294|**后置条件**:
 295|
 296|  - Result is displayed
 297|
 298|  - Calculation is recorded in history (if valid)
 299|
 300|**业务规则**:
 301|
 302|  - Division by zero is not allowed
 303|
 304|  - Input must be numeric
 305|
 306|### UC-02: Perform Chained Calculation
 307|
 308|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 309|
 310|**前置条件**:
 311|
 312|  - A previous calculation result is displayed
 313|
 314|**主流程**:
 315|
 316|  1. 1. User selects an operator (e.g., *)
 317|
 318|  2. 2. User enters next operand (e.g., 2)
 319|
 320|  3. 3. System computes result using previous result as first operand (e.g., 8 * 2 = 16)
 321|
 322|  4. 4. System displays new result
 323|
 324|  5. 5. System records the chain as a single calculation? Or each step? Assume each step is recorded.
 325|
 326|**备选流程**:
 327|
 328|  - **当 User starts new calculation**:
 329|
 330|      - 1a. User presses clear or enters new number
 331|
 332|      - 2a. Chain is reset
 333|
 334|**后置条件**:
 335|
 336|  - New result is displayed
 337|
 338|  - Chain step is recorded in history
 339|
 340|**业务规则**:
 341|
 342|  - Chain continues until reset
 343|
 344|### UC-03: View History
 345|
 346|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 347|
 348|**前置条件**:
 349|
 350|  - History contains at least one entry
 351|
 352|**主流程**:
 353|
 354|  1. 1. User requests history view
 355|
 356|  2. 2. System displays list of past calculations with expression and result, most recent first
 357|
 358|**备选流程**:
 359|
 360|  - **当 History is empty**:
 361|
 362|      - 2a. System displays 'No history' message
 363|
 364|**后置条件**:
 365|
 366|  - History is displayed
 367|
 368|**业务规则**:
 369|
 370|  - History is limited to 100 entries
 371|
 372|### UC-04: Clear History
 373|
 374|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 375|
 376|**前置条件**:
 377|
 378|  - History contains at least one entry
 379|
 380|**主流程**:
 381|
 382|  1. 1. User selects clear history option
 383|
 384|  2. 2. System removes all history entries
 385|
 386|  3. 3. System confirms history cleared
 387|
 388|**后置条件**:
 389|
 390|  - History is empty

  29|
  30|### ADR-001: Use Decimal for Precise Arithmetic
  31|
  32|- **状态**: Accepted
  33|
  34|- **背景**: Floating-point precision issues in decimal calculations [RISK-01]
  35|
  36|- **决策**: Use Python's Decimal type for all arithmetic operations
  37|

  43|
  44|### ADR-002: Left-to-Right Evaluation Without Precedence
  45|
  46|- **状态**: Accepted
  47|
  48|- **背景**: Chain calculation order of operations ambiguity [RISK-02]
  49|
  50|- **决策**: Evaluate chain calculations strictly left-to-right without operator precedence
  51|
  52|- **后果**: Simple and predictable behavior; users must use parentheses if needed
  53|
  54|- **考虑的替代方案**:
  55|
  56|  - Standard precedence (PEMDAS): Increased complexity for simple calculator

  21|# 设计概述

  23|
  24|## 1.1 系统架构
  25|
  26|**架构模式**: layered
  27|
  28|## 1.2 关键设计决策 (ADR)
  29|
  30|### ADR-001: Use Decimal for Precise Arithmetic
  31|
  32|- **状态**: Accepted
  33|
  34|- **背景**: Floating-point precision issues in decimal calculations [RISK-01]
  35|
  36|- **决策**: Use Python's Decimal type for all arithmetic operations
  37|
  38|- **后果**: Eliminates floating-point rounding errors; slight performance overhead
  39|
  40|- **考虑的替代方案**:
  41|
  42|  - Use float: Floating-point precision issues
  43|
  44|### ADR-002: Left-to-Right Evaluation Without Precedence
  45|
  46|- **状态**: Accepted
  47|
  48|- **背景**: Chain calculation order of operations ambiguity [RISK-02]
  49|
  50|- **决策**: Evaluate chain calculations strictly left-to-right without operator precedence
  51|
  52|- **后果**: Simple and predictable behavior; users must use parentheses if needed
  53|
  54|- **考虑的替代方案**:
  55|
  56|  - Standard precedence (PEMDAS): Increased complexity for simple calculator
  57|
  58|
  59|## 1.3 设计目标
  60|
  61|- **可维护性**: 模块化设计，单一职责原则
  62|- **可测试性**: 依赖注入，接口隔离
  63|- **安全性**: 纵深防御，最小权限原则
  64|- **可扩展性**: 开放/封闭原则，策略模式

 214|## 2.9 时序图
 215|
 216|### Perform Basic Calculation
 217|
 218|```mermaid
 219|sequenceDiagram
 220|    participant User
 221|    participant CLI
 222|    participant Calculator
 223|    participant History
 224|    User->>CLI: enter operand1, operator, operand2
 225|    CLI->>Calculator: add/subtract/multiply/divide(operand1, operand2)
 226|    Calculator-->>CLI: result
 227|    Calculator->>History: record(CalculationRecord)
 228|    CLI-->>User: display result
 229|```
 230|
 231|### Chain Calculation
 232|
 233|```mermaid
 234|sequenceDiagram
 235|    participant User
 236|    participant CLI
 237|    participant Calculator
 238|    participant History
 239|    User->>CLI: enter operator, operand
 240|    CLI->>Calculator: chain_calculate([(operator, operand)])
 241|    Calculator->>Calculator: use previous result as first operand
 242|    Calculator-->>CLI: new result
 243|    Calculator->>History: record(CalculationRecord)
 244|    CLI-->>User: display new result
 245|```

 249|```mermaid
 250|sequenceDiagram
 251|    participant User
 252|    participant CLI
 253|    participant Calculator
 254|    User->>CLI: request history
 255|    CLI->>Calculator: get_history()
 256|    Calculator-->>CLI: list of CalculationRecord
 257|    CLI-->>User: display history

 260|## 2.10 状态机图
 261|
 262|### Calculator 状态机
 263|
 264|```mermaid
 265|stateDiagram-v2
 266|    [*] --> Idle
 267|    Idle --> AwaitingOperand: user enters first operand
 268|    AwaitingOperand --> AwaitingOperator: user enters operator
 269|    AwaitingOperator --> AwaitingOperand: user enters second operand
 270|    AwaitingOperand --> DisplayResult: calculation performed
 271|    DisplayResult --> Idle: user clears or continues
 272|    DisplayResult --> AwaitingOperator: chain calculation
 273|```

 290|## 3.2 关键接口
 291|
 292|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 293|  - 签名: `add(a: float, b: float) -> float`
 294|  - 描述: Returns the sum of a and b
 295|
 296|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 297|  - 签名: `subtract(a: float, b: float) -> float`
 298|  - 描述: Returns the difference of a and b
 299|
 300|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 301|  - 签名: `multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float`
 302|  - 描述: Returns the product of a and b
 303|
 304|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 305|  - 签名: `divide(a: float, b: float) -> float`
 306|  - 描述: Returns the quotient of a and b; raises ValueError on division by zero
 307|
 308|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 309|  - 签名: `chain_calculate(operations: List[Tuple[str, float]]) -> float`
 310|  - 描述: Performs chain calculation left-to-right starting from current result
 311|
 312|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 313|  - 签名: `get_history() -> List[CalculationRecord]`
 314|  - 描述: Returns list of all past calculations
 315|
 316|- **Calculator** (`calculator`)
 317|  - 签名: `clear_history() -> None`
 318|  - 描述: Clears all history records
